title: Per-socket documentation infrastructure + migrate all 80 nodes
description: Adds a required MeshNode.socketDocs() map from port name to description. MeshNodeCatalog serializes these into the per-port 'description' key in mesh-node-catalog.json, and Daud's _format_node_summary renders them as indented bullets under each node signature in the agent system prompt. A new test unit.mesh.MeshNodePortDocumentationTest iterates MeshNodeRegistry_MeshNodes.MAP and hard-fails the build if any input or output port lacks a non-empty doc entry. Migrated all 80 registered nodes (353 ports) in one pass. Pairs with VOYAGE-42: cube.size now carries the 'extent = size; vertices at ±s/2' guidance directly on the port.
definition-of-done: 1. MeshNode.socketDocs() added as default-empty method. 2. MeshNodeSchema.socketDocs field + from() propagation. 3. MeshNodeCatalog.serializeInputs/Outputs threads per-port description into JSON. 4. MeshNodePortDocumentationTest goes red before migration and green after. 5. All 80 nodes override socketDocs() with a map covering every input and output port. 6. Daud _format_node_summary renders per-port descriptions.
testing-plan: 1. Run mvn test -Dtest=MeshNodePortDocumentationTest - green. 2. Regenerate catalog via export-mesh-catalog profile - cube and transform_geometry show per-port description keys. 3. build_mesh_system_prompt() output shows indented bullets under cube with the size socket doc.
